item.text: {"summary":"The draft is mostly publication-ready, but the interval calculation is internally inconsistent with the stated historical sample.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"blocking","summary":"The stated 2023-Q2 to 2026-Q1 sample contains only 0.2-0.4 values, which does not support sigma = 0.22 or 80% bounds of roughly 0.0 to 0.6 as written.","actionRequested":"Either cite/use a longer or different realized-volatility sample that actually supports sigma = 0.22 and the 0.0-0.6 interval, or revise the interval method and bounds to match the stated sample."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Keep the ledger source URL and the more specific NBB flash-estimate URL aligned or explain why the specific URL is used as the resolution page.","Consider naming whether the Eurostat history is revised history or first-print-like history, since the target is first print."]}
